criteria.text: stub gh in a writable PATH dir → the review leg refuses on a sound lane / marks advisory otherwise; a system-bin gh works; resolution happens before any NC execution.
criteria.witness: verify.py: _Authority.resolve() is called in main() before verify() (so before every check and the executed control); shutil.which runs ONCE, the PATH entry is pinned absolute and fetch_reviews/fetch_pr_author invoke only _Authority.gh. classify(): system-bin PATH dir → system; a binary resolving under a work tree, the temp dir, or a user-writable dir → worker-writable. check_review → _Authority.review_leg(): worker-writable + lane claiming soundness → fatal 'review_authority: gh at <path> is worker-writable … fail-closed (h409 F-1)'; native lane → 'NOTE: review_authority: advisory (gh at <path> is worker-writable)'. Tests: ReviewAuthorityPinnedBeforeTheControl::test_a_gh_dropped_by_the_executed_control_never_answers_the_review_leg (the C5 reproduction end to end: check.py plants a gh in an EMPTY writable dir first on PATH during --execute-nc; the planted gh's log never appears; the pre-pinned stand-in answers and the run is exit 2 'cannot fetch reviews' — on the pre-F-1 verifier this test is RED with exit 0, the false GREEN), ::test_a_worker_writable_gh_is_fatal_on_a_sound_lane (--provenance ci → exit 2 naming provenance=ci), ::test_a_worker_writable_gh_is_advisory_on_the_native_lane (exit 0 + the NOTE), ::test_a_system_gh_is_classed_system.

criteria.text: no --repo on a sound lane → refuse; inferred repo → advisory + recorded.
criteria.witness: verify.py: _Authority.resolve(explicit_repo) records repo_source explicit|inferred; review_leg(): inferred + sound lane → fatal 'review_repo: … inferred from the clone's origin … requires an explicit --repo; fail-closed (h409 F-2)'; native lane → 'NOTE: review_repo: advisory (<repo> inferred from origin, not pinned by the coordinator)'. --provenance is a verify.py flag now, forwarded from ORCA_PROVENANCE by verify-gate.sh, signed in the transcript's args (run_report SIGNED_ARGS mirrors it). Tests: ReviewRepoIsCoordinatorPinned::test_no_repo_on_a_sound_lane_refuses_to_infer, ::test_no_repo_on_the_native_lane_is_advisory_and_recorded, ::test_an_explicit_repo_on_a_sound_lane_passes_without_the_note, ::test_the_transcript_signs_the_provenance. docs/verify-gate.md ORCA_REPO/ORCA_PROVENANCE wording updated.

criteria.text: 0644 / git-tracked / unignored seed → refuse with the custody class named; 0600 out-of-repo seed signs; stderr names the custody class.
criteria.witness: dispatch-sign.py _seed(): stat → any group/other bit → refuse 'seed custody: <path> is mode 0644 — readable beyond its owner …'; _in_unignored_worktree → refuse 'seed custody: <path> is inside a git work tree that does not ignore it …'; a passing seed prints 'seed custody: <path> mode 0600, outside any unignored work tree' to stderr. Shared by all four signers: sign and sign-transcript call it; inventory.py _read_seed already did; verify.py _Transcript.seed now loads dispatch-sign.py and calls it. Tests: SeedCustodyAtUse (dispatch-sign, both subcommands × 0644 / committed-unignored / 0600-out-of-repo / ignored-in-repo), TranscriptKeyCustody (verify.py: 0644 → exit 1 before any verdict and no transcript written; in-repo unignored → exit 1; 0600 out-of-repo signs + names class), SeedCustodyAtSign (inventory.py sign: 0644 → could-not-run, nothing signed; 0600 signs + names class). 4/4 signers RED on the pre-fix code. Fixtures across test_verify/test_run_report/test_inventory/test_dispatch_sign that wrote seeds 0644 in-repo were the same blind spot and now create seeds the way gen-key leaves them.

criteria.text: sibling substitution → run_report binding fails; an unmodified toolchain binds.
criteria.witness: verify.py _Transcript.TOOLCHAIN = (verify.py, _verify_sig.py, diff_scope.py, ed25519.py, dispatch-sign.py) hashed per file into toolchain.files (verify_sha256 kept = files['verify.py']). run_report.py TOOLCHAIN_FILES mirrors the set; signed_transcript() refuses to bind when toolchain.files is absent, partial, names a file unreadable at the pin, or a hash differs from sha256(runtime/scripts/<name> at rev) — documented as binding the verifier's identity, nothing more. Tests: TranscriptBindsTheVerifierToolchain::test_an_unmodified_toolchain_binds, ::test_a_substituted_sibling_does_not_bind (_verify_sig.py hash of an always-True _failure_signature), ::test_a_transcript_naming_no_toolchain_set_does_not_bind, ::test_a_partial_toolchain_set_does_not_bind. The unit's own transcript (fix-transcript.json) carries toolchain.files for the five files at head.

intent.goal: Fix the five h409 classes so every confirmed reproduction now REFUSES: the review authority pinned before any worker code runs (F-1), the review repository coordinator-pinned on sound lanes (F-2), one spelling for ./-evidence on both sides (F-3), seed custody re-asserted at every signing (F-4), the transcript naming and run_report binding the verifier file set (F-5).
intent.non_goals: no new dependency, no network in any script, the unsigned no-key path unchanged, no change to WHAT verify.py checks (only the trust of the channels it checks through), no PR action.
intent.stop_conditions_hit: none — no existing refusal weakened; the GitHub review contract untouched (the authority resolution was the bug).
intent.ruled_out: Scrubbing env / running the NC under a fixed PATH instead of pinning the authority (the spec names resolution-before-execution as the class fix; env scrubbing would also change the NC's contract); classifying gh custody by realpath alone (Homebrew's /opt/homebrew/bin/gh resolves into a user-owned Cellar, so the spec's standard-system-bin carve-out is applied to the PATH entry's dir); treating `dispatch` provenance as non-sound (verify-gate.sh's own sound case lists ci|mcp|sdk|dispatch, so it is sound here too — the stricter direction); raising the verify.py width pin (held at 91 by folding the single-use _WAIVER_NEEDS_EXECUTED_NC into check_review); failing verify.py itself when the custody NOTE fires on the native lane (the spec says advisory there).
intent.why: C5 is the P0 clause verbatim: worker-authored test code making verify.py exit 0 over a forged review, in one run, on the strongest lane the gate offers. C1–C4 are the same shape at smaller scale — each a trust edge where the verifier consulted something the graded worker could have written.
